town_description: Kohima is the capital of Nagaland in the Naga Hills of north-east India, known for the Kohima War Cemetery, the Naga Heritage Village at Kisama, and the Hornbill Festival (1-10 December). The population is overwhelmingly Naga and Christian; Hindu temples are few and serve the non-Naga community - Durgabari, the Nepali Mandir on P.R. Hill, Kohima Hindu Mandir and the Gorkha Singhadevi Mandir are the documented ones.

travel.airport: Dimapur Airport, about 70-75 km by road (verify).
travel.road: Kohima is on NH-2 (Imphal-Dimapur highway) and NH-29; taxis and buses run from Dimapur (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for cool, clear weather; the Hornbill Festival (1-10 December) is the most vibrant period (verify).
